steps.title: Analyze Storage Access Requirements

steps.description: Update BackupRestoreHelper to parse ZIP database records directly from user-picked InputStream.

steps.description: Implement Intent.ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT to allow users to select target folder and filename for ZIP export.

steps.description: Implement Intent.ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT to prompt users to choose target ZIP file for ledger restoration.

steps.description: Add onActivityResult logic to process URI streams for both backup export and restore import actions.

steps.title: Enhance Settings UI Feedback
steps.description: Update backup and restore buttons with clear prompts and user notifications.

steps.description: Ensure customer profiles, top-up additions, interest options, and payment allocations are fully retained across import/export.
